page_data.en:
It will be noted in the attached history of
Kindler as related by himself that he says nothing
about the reason why he left Singapore, nothing
about a Warrant being issued for his arrest
there, nothing about being an offender and a
fugitive from justice, nothing about the scheme
which he propounded to the Police, to sell boxes
of sand representing them to be filled with
revolvers to a member of the Kuomintang with the
intention of swindling him out of a big sum
of money, nothing about the plot in which he
suggested that he would obtain a quantity of
counterfeit coin and place in the chimney of the
house of Ettinger with a view to getting the
latter arrested by the Police and convicted on a
trumped up charge and nothing about the storing
of arms, gatherings of German volunteers and other
sensational items all of which on investigations
turned out to be fabrications of a most
flaring type,
gives useless information...

（批：So 503）

在附上的 Kindler 自述经历中可以注意到，他对自己离开新加坡的原因只字未提，对那里签发逮捕他的令状只字未提，对自己是一名罪犯和司法逃犯只字未提，对他向警方提出的将装满沙子的箱子谎称为装有左轮手枪并以此诈骗一名国民党成员巨额钱财的计划只字未提，对他建议获取大量假币并放入 Ettinger 住宅烟囱内、意图使后者被警方逮捕并以捏造的罪名定罪的阴谋只字未提，对储存武器、德国志愿者集会以及其他耸人听闻的事项也只字未提，而经调查，所有这些事项均被证实为极其荒诞的捏造，
提供无用信息……

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by
Sir,
Enquiries have been made regarding attached, but no information
has been obtained to show that Max Kindler, the Nanking Road dentist,

I am, Sir,

REPORT ON Pass Port Traffic.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by

Sir,
    While at the Norwegian Consulate yesterday in connection with
the Kalleberg pass port case, I recognized the Chinese interpreter
as a former friend, and had a conversation with him. He told me
that some six week ago Max Kindler, the Austrian dentist, went to
the Norwegian Consulate, and gave the assistant interpreter $100.00 to get
him a pass port form, and promised to give $400.00 more if the interpreter
would stamp the pass port after it had been filled in and a
photograph attached. The interpreter went on to say that when his
assistant reported to him what had taken place, he instructed the
assistant to return the money. Kindler did not make it clear as
to whether the pass port was for himself or not. I promised the
interpreter to treat his story as confidential.
    Judgement was reserved in the case against Kalleberg.

23/8
                        I am, Sir,
                        Your obedient servant,
                        D.S.Givens
                        Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

August 14th, 1916.

REPORT ON Watch on Kindler.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.

Sir,
I beg to report that Kindler, the Austrian dentist, was watched from 8th instant to 14th instant inclusive. He lives at No. 39 N. Soochow Road, a boarding house, kept by Mrs. Sterberg, a Roumanian. He goes to his office, No. 35 Nanking Road about 9 a.m. daily, and comes home for tiffin about noon. He leaves again for the office at 2 p.m. and returns home about 5 p.m. He does not remain constantly in his office, but goes about a good deal.

During the period that Kindler was watched he visited the following places:-
Dr. ● O. Fisher's office at No. 112 Szechuen Road.    7 times
Palace Hotel ....................................    3 ,,
Palace Hotel Annexe...............................    1 time
The Pharmacy of Dr.J.D.Chang,No.83 Nanking Road....    1 ,,
The German Consulate..............................    4 times
,, ,, Club........................................    2 ,,

He probably called on Mr. Winkler or Mr. Milkowski of the Austrian Consular Service in the Palace Hotel.

Several Chinese, including many Cantonese, visited Kindler office whilst he was being shadowed, but no foreigners, Indians, Japanese or Koreans were seen to enter his place.

Kindler is in very poor circumstances at present and it is said that he will soon be obliged to give up his office in Nanking Road, for the rent of which he is being sued at present by the Tobaqueria Fillipina.

D.S.C.
K.
15/8/16.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J.P.Givens
Detective Sergeant.

四川路112号 Dr. ● O. Fisher 的诊所。    7次
华懋饭店 ....................................    3 ,,

No. 508
Date 9/8/16

COPY.
August 8th
6

Sir,
Five Germans who were inhabiting No.35 Wayside Road
left that address on August 5the.
There has been a serious split amongst the souteneurs
who inhabit Hongkew. Ettinger of Nanzing Road has
had a quarrel with Spun, the licensee of the Hague
and also with Kindler the dentist.
He wrote or is alleged to have written several
anonymous letters denouncing Spun and one of
these he addressed to himself, opened it and read
to some Austrian and German persons in the Public
Garden. Spun heard of this and is now suing
Ettinger for defamation of character. The case is
pending in the German Consulate.
Ettinger adopted similar tactics with Kindler and
spread the news that he was bankrupt and could not pay
his debts. This caused Berthel who has lent Kindler
$400.00 to call and demanded repayment of the loan.
Kindler paid $50.00 of the sum and asked for time
which was granted.
Kindler alleges that the German Consul is anxious
to punish Ettinger because he broke faith with him,
defrauded of money and betrayed certain Russians who
were engaged to blow up bridges on the Trans-siberian
Railway into the hands of the Chief of Police at Harbin.
Kindler has got the story of Moses of Jerusalem
from a recent arrival from India named Marcus Goldstern
who left Shanghai for Singapore on August 7th to open
a public house there and who claims to have been the
official interpreter at the trial of Moses and he is
able to enlarge on the part that Ettinger played in this.
He is very anxious to "fix" Ettinger for the harm he
has done and proposes to place a quantity of counterfeit
coin surreptitiously in Ettinger's house, then call
on the Police and get Ettinger sent to prison.
Joseph Rotiman is apparently in consultation with
Kindler but the latter claims that it is only on
matters connected with his teeth.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

先生，
居住在路边路35号的五名德国人已于8月5日离开该地址。
居住在虹口的皮条客之间发生了严重分裂。南京路的 Ettinger 与海格公寓（Hague）的持牌人 Spun 以及牙医 Kindler 发生了争吵。
他写了几封匿名信谴责 Spun，或者据称是他写的，其中一封他寄给了自己，拆开并在公共花园读给一些奥地利人和德国人听。Spun 得知此事，现在正因诽谤罪起诉 Ettinger。该案正在德国领事馆审理中。
Ettinger 对 Kindler 采取了类似的手段，散布他破产且无力偿还债务的消息。这导致借给 Kindler 400.00美元的 Berthel 前来要求偿还贷款。Kindler 支付了其中的50.00美元，并请求宽限时间，该请求获准。
Kindler 声称，德国领事急于惩罚 Ettinger，是因为 Ettinger 背信弃义，诈骗钱财，并将某些受雇炸毁西伯利亚大铁路桥梁的俄国人出卖给了哈尔滨警察局长。
Kindler 从一位名叫 Marcus Goldstern 的近期抵沪人士那里得到了关于耶路撒冷的 Moses 的故事，此人于8月7日离开上海前往新加坡开设酒馆，并声称自己是 Moses 审判期间的官方翻译，他能够详细阐述 Ettinger 在此事中扮演的角色。
他非常希望能因 Ettinger 造成的伤害而“整治”他，并提议秘密将大量假币放入 Ettinger 的家中，然后报警，使 Ettinger 入狱。
Joseph Rotiman 显然正在与 Kindler 商议，但后者声称这仅与牙齿相关事务有关。

您的顺从仆人，

首席侦探督察。

警务处总监。

(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

August 8th 1918
FILED

Sir,
Five Germans who were inhabiting No.35 Wayside Road
left that address on August 5th.
There has been a serious split amongst the sojourners
who inhabit Hongkew. Ettinger of Nanzing Road has
had a quarrel with Spun, the licensee of the Hague
and also with Kindler the dentist.
He wrote or is alleged to have written several
anonymous letters denouncing Spun and one of
these he addressed to himself, opened it and read
to some Austrian and German persons in the Public
Garden. Spun heard of this and is now suing
Ettinger for defamation of character. The case is
pending in the German Consulate.
Ettinger adopted similar tactics with Kindler and
spread the news that he was bankrupt and could not pay
his debts. This caused Berthel who has lent Kindler
$400.00 to call and demanded repayment of the loan.
Kindler paid $50.00 of the sum and asked for time
which was granted.
Kindler alleges that the German Consul is anxious
to punish Ettinger because he broke faith with him,
defrauded of money and betrayed certain Russians who
were engaged to blow up bridges on the Tran-siberian
Railway into the hands of the Chief of Police at Harbin.
Kindler has got the story of Moses of Jerusalem
from a recent arrival from India named Marco Goldstein
who left Shanghai for Singapore on August 7th to open
a public house there and who claims to have been the
official interpreter at the trial of Moses, and he is
able to enlarge on the part that Ettinger played in this.
He is very anxious to "fix" Ettinger for the harm he
has done and proposes to place a quantity of counterfeit
coin surreptitiously in Ettinger's house, then call
on the Police and get Ettinger sent to prison.
Joseph Rothman is apparently in consultation with
Kindler but the latter claims that it is only on
matters connected with his teeth. /

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmnnnustina
Chief Detective Inspector.

alleged dealing in arms, and can
find nothing substantial to proceed on
The whole affair apparently a put-up
job by undesirables, with a view to
defraud Chinese and use the Police as

utmost caution.

                  Shanghai, April, 15, 1916.

REPORT ON attempted deal in arms.

Made by D.S.I.Brewster        Forwarded by
                                          ✓

Sir
    D.C.Schmidt reported today that he had been approached by a
Mr M.Kindler, an Austrian Dentist whose surgery is situated at No
34 Nanking Road. Mr Kindler visited Schmidt at his house
about 1. a.m this morning and explained that a number of Chinese
were coming to his office at 9,30 a.m.today to buy, pay for, and
take away a box containing 100 pistols for which they were to pay
$68.00 each. He proposed that Schmidt be present on the street
outside his office when those Chinese were leaving with the box
which he wanted Schmidt to seize and allow the Chinese to get away.
He proposed to swindle the Chinese by filling the box with sand
and having a few pistols on top. This would result in his recei-
ving about $7,000. for about half a dozen pistols and of this Schm-
idt was to receive $2,000. The Chinese who escaped would of
course still be under the impression that the deal was honest and
the pistols seized by the Police. As a result of the above report
Schmidt, D.S.Givens and myself, acting under your instructions
waited near the entrance to Kindler,s surgery this morning . No-
thing happened and finally Schmidt interviewed Kindler who said
that a Japanese middleman named Kawano whose car is attached had
not arrived with the box. Kindler will visit Schmidt again at
his home at 4 p m this afternoon when further arrangements will be
made. He suspects that the Japanese is trying to make the deal
on his own account.

                        Your Obedient Servant
Chief Det Insp.         W B newton.

先生
    施密特副督察（D.C.Schmidt）今天报告说，他受到了一位 M.金德勒（M.Kindler）先生的接触，这是一位奥地利牙医，其诊所位于南京路34号。金德勒先生于今天凌晨1点左右到施密特家中拜访，解释说有一群中国人将于今天上午9:30来到他的办公室，购买、付款并取走一箱装有100支手枪的箱子，每支手枪价格为68.00美元。他提议，当那些中国人带着箱子离开时，施密特应在他办公室外的街道上在场，他希望施密特扣押箱子并让中国人逃走。他提议用沙子装满箱子，上面放几支手枪，以此诈骗中国人。这将使他通过大约半打手枪获得约7,000美元，其中施密特将获得2,000美元。逃走的中国人当然仍会认为交易是诚实的，只是手枪被警方扣押了。基于上述报告，施密特、吉文斯副督察（D.S.Givens）和我本人，按照您的指示，今天上午在金德勒诊所入口附近等候。什么也没发生，最后施密特会见了金德勒，金德勒说名为河野（Kawano）的日本中间人及其附属车辆尚未带着箱子到达。金德勒将于今天下午4点再次到施密特家中拜访，届时将做出进一步安排。他怀疑这名日本人试图独自达成交易。

REPORT ON Max Kindler a Undersirable Character .
Made by Sub-Inspt Cruickshank .    Forwarded by
Sir .
This man was wanted in Singapore for Embezzlement last year .He came to Shanghai about November 1914 in company with a woman who he alleged was his wife , They resided at No 23 North Szechuen Road, Shortly after his arrival in Shanghai he went into partnership with Morris River, also a undesirable,and they opened a Dentist Shop in Nanking Road . I believe the concern was Financed by Mr Neumann ,German Butcher . Shortly after the opening of the dentist shop there was a split in the partnership and the dispute was settled at the Austrian Consulate . Shortly afterwards the woman who accompanied him to Shanghai left him and another woman known to us by the name of Sarah or Polly De'Blinde ( but this is only an assumed name ) came into the picture . This woman had been formerly an inmate of several brothels in Shanghai and was a well known character in that profession about 9 or 10 years ago , She was formerly connected with a man named Leichner an Austrian subject and we had a lot of correspondences regarding this man with the French and Austrian Authorities , On the last occasion when De'Blinde came to Shanghai about 6 months ago she was a Bar maid at the Hague Hotel . Shortly afterwards she is alleged to have married Kindler and they are now living together as husband and wife. Kindler is now a member of the Shanghai Volunteers and attached to the Austrian Company and I have seen him in that uniform .

Wanted on a Warrant charging him with Criminal Breach of Trust of various sums amounting to $555. at Singapore the property of Messrs Lowe Bingham & Matthews, George Ingles, age about 30 years, height about 5 ft. 5 ins., Fair hair parted on left side, blue grey eyes, medium build, one gold tooth on right side of upper jaw, pale complexion, nose has been broken, lines running from each side of mouth very noticeable, speaks with a Scottish accent.
